```sql
SELECT ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, g.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM parks p
JOIN (
    SELECT geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Golden Gate Bridge Lookout%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Sausalito%'
    LIMIT 1
) g ON ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, g.geometry::geography, 10000)
WHERE p.leisure = 'golf_course'
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> g.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```
